:::{#about-me}

Hello !<br>
My name is Hieu Duong (Dương Xuân Hiếu in Vietnamese). I'm an AI Engineer at [FPT Smart Cloud](https://fptsmartcloud.com/en/home/). My current work focuses on research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agents for real-world applications, such as chatbot systems and recommendation systems. I also conduct research in various fields related to Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a particular focus on Vietnamese (my mother tongue) and English. My research interests include Information Retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Language Models.<br><br>
In addition to my professional work, I enjoy reading and writing blogs about life experiences and personal reflections.

:::
